entries.replica.fr1.text: Look, a ~house in the middle of the forest~! Let's go closer..
entries.replica.fr2.text: Bir çeşit tarif gibi görünüyor. Bunların hepsini karıştırırsak ne olur acaba?
entries.replica.fr3.text: Aaa, ne kadar ~tatlı bir kedi~! Seni buraya kim bırakmış?
entries.replica.fr5.text: Well then.. Come with me, little friend!
entries.replica.fr7.text: Good, now we can go back home.
entries.replica.r1.text: Oh! Looks like there is another ~mushroom glade~ nearby.
entries.replica.r10.text: The potion revealed a ~new page~ in the notebook! It looks like a ~map of the area~!
entries.replica.r101.text: Great, our ~supplies are replenished~! Time to move on.
entries.replica.r102.text: From now on, I will carry the flour.
entries.replica.r103.text: Görünüşe göre çizmelerin şarjı bitti. Bir ~mola~ verelim, çevreden kök toplayıp çizmeleri şarj edelim.
entries.replica.r104.text: Şimdi ~çizmeleri şarj ederiz~ ve yola devam ederiz!
entries.replica.r105.text: Great, the ~boots are charged~, the tent is packed. Time to go!
entries.replica.r106.text: Attention, friends! We are entering the ~Dark Forest~. Stay alert.
entries.replica.r11.text: We need to feed you. We happen to have a ~bottle of milk~ right here.
entries.replica.r110.text: Ne? Burada biri mi var? Bir saniye, ~monoklümü~ çıkarayım.
entries.replica.r111.text: I did not mean to scare you. But I am in ~trouble~. I lost my beloved french horn! With one eye I just cannot find it.
entries.replica.r112b.text: Bakın! İhtiyacınız olan alet bu mu?
entries.replica.r112bb.text: No, that is a cello. And my instrument is a ~wind instrument~!
entries.replica.r112cc.text: Warmer! But that still is not a french horn. It is an ordinary ~trumpet~.
entries.replica.r113.text: Here is your ~french horn~, Mr. Cyclops!
entries.replica.r114.text: Thank you so much! I can ~play~ again! Let me guide you to the edge of the dark forest.
entries.replica.r115.text: As thanks for helping me - here is a ~bucket of strawberries~. Farewell!
entries.replica.r117.text: Meanwhile, the boots ran out of charge again. They hardly hold any charge at all!
entries.replica.r118.text: Half the journey is behind us! Next our path leads through ~Flower Valley~.
entries.replica.r119.text: Wow! I have never been to Flower Valley, but they say it is ~beautiful~ there!
entries.replica.r120.text: In any case, let us stay vigilant, friends!
entries.replica.r122.text: Looks like I worried for nothing. I will fly ~scouting ahead~ and see what interesting things lie before us!
entries.replica.r123.text: The owlet is taking a ~long~ time to come back.
entries.replica.r124.text: Look, there are some ~weird little folks~ over there. Let us ask them the way!
entries.replica.r125.text: Hello! We are ~gnomes~, and we know these lands very well. We will show you the way.
entries.replica.r126.text: But first look what a ~magnificent bird~ we caught today! It will sing for us!
entries.replica.r128.text: But this bird cannot sing, it is an ~owlet~. What you need is a ~nightingale~!
entries.replica.r129.text: If it is a bird, it ~must sing~. We will only give your bird back in exchange for a nightingale, and that is final!
entries.replica.r131.text: We found a replacement for the nightingale. It is a ~Tape Recorder~!
entries.replica.r132.text: ~Strange~, it does not look like a bird...
entries.replica.r133.text: It is ~much better than a bird~! Your bird is free. And your path lies toward those mountains in the distance.
entries.replica.r134.text: Thank you, friends, for rescuing me. Now I will not fly far away from you again!
entries.replica.r136.text: And the heart feels anxious in the chest!
entries.replica.r137.text: Ve yine ~çizmeleri şarj etme~ vakti geldi...
entries.replica.r138.text: I hope this time the charge lasts all the way to the end!
entries.replica.r139.text: There is only one last stretch left. We are ~almost there~.
entries.replica.r14.text: The kitten ~refuses~ to drink milk, strange! Well, let us look in the notebook..
entries.replica.r140.text: ~Hanımefendi~ ile karşılaşınca bize ne diyecek acaba?
entries.replica.r15.text: Demek bizim kedimiz gerçekten ~Boris~ mi? ~Tuhaf zevkleri~ varmış. Hadi onu beslemeyi deneyelim!
entries.replica.r16.text: Şu ~sinek mantarını~ gerçekten koymalı mıyız? Zehirli ya... Eh, neyse artık!
entries.replica.r18.text: Looks like the kitty is thirsty now! And the notebook happens to have a recipe for how to ~give a cat a drink~!
entries.replica.r19.text: Ben de ~içeceği denesem~ mi? Yok, galiba riske girmeyeyim.
entries.replica.r2.text: Strange. I have never been here before, and yet everything feels ~somehow familiar~.
entries.replica.r22.text: Öyle görünüyor! Vay canına.. Peki sen kimsin?
entries.replica.r24.text: Hello, ~Em-ma~.. Unfortunately, I do not remember who I am or what my name is.
entries.replica.r25.text: I have a talking kitty who ~remembers nothing~. I think it is worth checking the notebook again.
entries.replica.r27.text: I remembered my name; it really is ~Boris~. At your service!
entries.replica.r28.text: Bu arada sende ~ayna~ var mı? Nasıl göründüğüme bakmak istiyorum. Belki başka bir şey daha hatırlarım.
entries.replica.r2b.text: I would not be surprised if the house contains that ~old chest~ I keep dreaming about.
entries.replica.r30.text: AAAAAAAA! AAAA! @Ben bir kediyim!@ Bu korkun?!
entries.replica.r32.text: Actually, I knew. I was just joking.. I suppose a ~new page~ opened in my mistress's diary.
entries.replica.r32b.text: Let us continue restoring the memory!
entries.replica.r33.text: I remember my mistress. A good, kind woman. I think she asked me to ~deliver something to someone~.
entries.replica.r34b.text: I cannot remember. But it seems to be ~very important~.
entries.replica.r34bb.text: The last potion will ~completely~ restore your memory!
entries.replica.r34c.text: I remember. The Mistress said: ~If I do not return by autumn, ask Em-ma for help~
entries.replica.r36.text: Bence o sensin. ~Gizli kulübeyi~ bulup bu kadar çok ~iksir~ yapabilecek başka kim var? Hanımefendiye yardım eder misin?
entries.replica.r37.text: Onun ne konuda yardıma ihtiyacı olduğunu bile bilmiyorum. Ya çocukları yiyorsa?
entries.replica.r38.text: Onun hakkında kötü konuşuyorlar. Çocuk yemez o. Yetişkinleri bile neredeyse hiç yemez. Yani yardım edecek misin?
entries.replica.r39.text: Ne kadar da @garip bir yer@! Buraya nasıl geldim?
entries.replica.r40.text: We need to get out of here as soon as possible.
entries.replica.r41.text: There is still no way out of the forest in sight...
entries.replica.r43.text: Bu gerçek bir ~tekboynuz~! Hey, bekle.. Nereye gidiyorsun?
entries.replica.r44.text: Tekboynuzun peşinden gideceğim. Belki beni ormandan çıkarır?
entries.replica.r45.text: The unicorn disappeared from view. But the forest is getting thinner here.
entries.replica.r46.text: Looks like I am on the ~right path~!
entries.replica.r47.text: Phew. I did not know I would be so happy to end up in a patch of ~normal forest~!
entries.replica.r48.text: I should look for something to eat.
entries.replica.r49.text: Now we need ~firewood~ to light a fire.
entries.replica.r5.text: The key was under the doormat! The owners took security ~seriously~.
entries.replica.r51.text: Buraya nereden çıktın? Ateş yakmana kim ~izin verdi~?
entries.replica.r52.text: I got lost and hungry. I just came out of the dark forest and …
entries.replica.r53.text: Kasvetli Orman'dan mı çıktın?! Oradan çıkış yok!
entries.replica.r54.text: Yoksa sen... Em-ma mısın? Hani şu ~efsane~deki?
entries.replica.r54b.text: Ne? Hayır, ben sıradan bir Emma'yım.
entries.replica.r55.text: Well, then everything is clear… You need to go north.
entries.replica.r56.text: Nihayet. Ben de ~bekliyordum~. Bu kadar neden geciktin?
entries.replica.r57.text: Well, I got into the dark forest and …
entries.replica.r58.text: Yes, yes. Everybody has heard the Legend. But I thought ~Great Em-ma~ would get out of the dark forest faster...
entries.replica.r59.text: We have little time - we need to find the ~Owlet~. He is the key to everything!
entries.replica.r6.text: İçinde ne var? Hadi çabuk bakalım!
entries.replica.r61.text: Yes. The Mistress had an Owlet. When everything ~went topsy-turvy~, he disappeared. Now we have to find him!
entries.replica.r62.text: Kimi getirdin? Bir baykuş yavrusu, güzel.. Ama bu ~bizim~ baykuş yavrumuz değil.
entries.replica.r64.text: Well, first of all he has a ~serious look~. Second, he is ~bigger~. And besides, he wears ~pink glasses~!
entries.replica.r65.text: Fena değil. Bunu daha önce söyleyemez miydin?
entries.replica.r66.text: İşte sonunda, ~yaramaz baykuş yavrusu~ bulundu. Nerelerde geziyordun?
entries.replica.r67.text: Dear kitty, I am so glad to see you again. You look so ~much better~!
entries.replica.r68.text: Yine başladın, dalkavuk kuş... Peki. Hanımefendiyi ~nerede bulacağını~ biliyor musun?
entries.replica.r69.text: Friends, I think we should ask the ~Crystal Sphere~ about it. It is kept in the attic.
entries.replica.r7.text: Looks like we gathered all the mushrooms! Now let us try to ~brew~ a potion!
entries.replica.r70.text: What a lovely attic! Well then, let us search.
entries.replica.r71.text: Forgive me, dear friends, I am about to recite secret spells. The Sphere ~does not understand~ any other way.
entries.replica.r74.text: ~The Mistress!~ My, she has been carried far away!
entries.replica.r75.text: Yeees... That is far away... We cannot get there on foot. We need ~boots~! There used to be a pair in the attic called ~"Swift Boots"~.
entries.replica.r78.text: I think good old Leshy knew ~how to recharge the boots~. Let us go to him!
entries.replica.r8.text: Into the cauldron go the ~ingredients~... And now let us ~cook~ a little...
entries.replica.r80.text: Merhaba, Sincap. Biz ~Orman Ruhuna~ gidiyoruz. Neden soruyorsun?
entries.replica.r81.text: Oh, nothing. Just being polite. Good luck to you!
entries.replica.r82.text: Strange - I have never seen this squirrel in our forest before.
entries.replica.r83.text: ~Çizmelerin şarjı mı bitti~ diyorsunuz? Bir tarifim vardı, bakayım...
entries.replica.r84.text: ..Aha, here! The recipe for a ~charging potion~. I cannot brew such a thing myself. It takes a special gift!
entries.replica.r85.text: Thank you for the recipe, Mr. Leshy! Now let us hurry, friends. We must ~save the Mistress~ as soon as possible!
entries.replica.r86.text: I have a plan: Owlet, you ~study the route~. Cat, you ~prepare the supplies~. I will ~gather roots~ for the potion in the meantime.
entries.replica.r87.text: All the ~ingredients are gathered~! Let us not waste time - into the cauldron go the boots!
entries.replica.r89.text: Great! The charge will last for ~three hundred versts~… Then we will have to recharge them again.
entries.replica.r90.text: Let us take supplies with us: a sack of flour, a jar of jam, and a camping cauldron. We will ~find the rest on the road~!
entries.replica.r91.text: I prepared a map. The campsites are marked with tents. A ~great adventure~ awaits us!
entries.replica.r94.text: Yakında mola var mı? Çok acıktım..
entries.replica.r96.text: Boris, what is happening to you??
entries.replica.r97.text: Sorry, friends.. I ~accidentally ~ate all our flour.
entries.replica.r98.text: Ah Boris, Boris.. Yakında ~kendine gelir~. Ama şimdi erzak olmadan Hanımefendiyi nasıl kurtaracağız?
entries.replica.r99.text: I have an idea! Let us gather some ~ears of wheat~ nearby and ~grind~ them with that abandoned watermill over there.
